purpose: Execute the atomic extrude-planar-profile operation within the MA-06 boundary: One fixed-distance transient extrusion. It does not create a profile, attach a DesignBody, perform target-face/up-to logic, or save a document.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires extrude-planar-profile and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: profile
inputs.description: A caller-supplied planar profile; profile construction is not part of this action.

inputs.name: distance_mm
inputs.description: Finite signed extrusion distance in millimetres; zero is rejected.

preconditions: distance_mm is finite and not within 1e-9 of zero.
profile is suitable for Modeler.Body.ExtrudeProfile and is expected to be a closed planar profile.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: A transient closed nonempty modeler body returned by ExtrudeProfile.

postconditions: The returned body passes assert_closed: IsClosed, PieceCount >= 1, and positive volume.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic extrude-planar-profile operation within the MA-06 boundary: One fixed-distance transient extrusion. It does not create a profile, attach a DesignBody, perform target-face/up-to logic, or save a document. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: No document selection is performed inside this action; supplied references are validated directly.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable for the transient result.

failure_modes.condition: Non-finite or near-zero distance raises ValueError.
failure_modes.detection: Non-finite or near-zero distance raises ValueError.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

failure_modes.condition: ExtrudeProfile returns a body that fails assert_closed or raises.
failure_modes.detection: ExtrudeProfile returns a body that fails assert_closed or raises.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use and retain only a clean run-owned state.

recovery.action: Supply a finite nonzero signed distance.
Discard the transient result, repair the profile/direction, and rerun.
